name: happy
why: A clear, specific creator with real demand signals. Tests that output is specific enough to pass the swap test: the copy must not read as if it could belong to any other creator.

input.description: I teach eggless baking to home cooks across small towns in India. Most of them have no oven at all, so everything I make works in a pressure cooker or a kadai. People constantly ask me why their cake sinks in the middle, and how to measure flour and sugar without a weighing scale since nobody here owns one.
